# Theia Markerless

> > Theia3D is a markerless motion capture platform using deep learning to analyze sports biomechanics, validated against marker-based systems for applications from baseball bat tracking to sprint running kinematics.

Theia Markerless provides professional-grade motion capture technology without markers or sensors, serving MLB teams, universities, and elite sports programs. The platform leverages deep learning and high-speed video to deliver precise biomechanical analysis across multiple sports and movement types.

## Core Products & Features

- [Bat Tracking](https://www.theiamarkerless.com/bat-tracking): Full-swing analysis using only high-speed video. No sensors, no markers. Built for MLB, collegiate, and elite development programs.
